name: Min-Max Phase 2: Peak Physique
author: Jeff Nippard
summary: 12 weeks, 4 days (Upper, Lower, Push, Pull). Low volume, high effort: 1-2 hard sets per exercise.

name: The Pure Bodybuilding Program (Push Pull Legs)
author: Jeff Nippard
summary: Runs on a 10-day cycle (not 7): 8 sessions of Pull, Push, Legs and Arms & Weak Points, each numbered #1 and #2, plus rest days. 10 cycles in two blocks: build, then novelty.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Lat Pull-Around
exercises.technique: Long-length Partials (on all reps of the last set)
exercises.note: Keep the cable and your wrist aligned in a straight line throughout the pull. Feel a nice, deep lat stretch at the top.

exercises.name: Snatch-Grip RDL
exercises.note: RPE is intentionally low (~6-7) because these cause high muscle damage. 1s pause at the bottom of each rep; stop ~75% of the way to full lockout (bottom 3/4 ROM) to keep tension on the hamstrings.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
exercises.technique: Long-length Partials (on all reps of the last set)
exercises.note: Flare elbows out at roughly 45° and squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Straight-Bar Lat Prayer
exercises.technique: Long-length Partials (on all reps of the last set)
exercises.note: Lean forward to get a big stretch on the lats at the top of the ROM, then stand upright as you squeeze your lats at the bottom.

exercises.name: Hammer Preacher Curl
exercises.note: Targets brachialis and forearms hard. Squeeze the dumbbell hard in the middle of the handle and curl ~3/4 of the way up (stay in the bottom 3/4 of the curl).

exercises.name: Lying Paused Rope Face Pull
exercises.note: Pause for 1-2 seconds in the squeeze of each rep. Contract the rear delts hard.

exercises.name: Cuffed Behind-The-Back Lateral Raise
exercises.note: Raise the cables up and out in a 'Y' motion. Connect with the middle delt fibers as you sweep the weight up and out.

exercises.name: Low Incline Smith Machine Press
exercises.note: Set bench at ~15° incline. 1 second pause on the chest on each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

exercises.name: Pec Deck (w/ Integrated Partials)
subs: Bent-Over Cable Pec Flye (w/ Integrated Partials)
exercises.note: Set up for maximum stretch. On all sets, alternate 1 full-ROM rep and 1 half-ROM rep in the stretched/bottom half until reaching target reps at RPE 9-10.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension (Bar)
exercises.note: Feel a deep stretch on the triceps throughout the entire negative. Pause for 1 second in the stretched position on each rep.

exercises.name: Triceps Pressdown (Bar)
exercises.note: Meant to be fairly heavy using a bar instead of a rope. Aim to add weight week to week while keeping form tight.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.note: Round your lower back as you crunch. Maintain a strong mind-muscle connection with your abs.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: Lean forward over the machine to get a maximum stretch in your hamstrings.

exercises.name: Machine Hip Adduction
exercises.note: Focus on a strong mind-muscle connection with your inner thighs; push these hard for front thigh mass.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.note: Reverse pyramid: warm up to your heaviest working set for 4 reps, drop 10-15% for 6 reps on set 2, then drop another 10-15% for 8 reps on set 3.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.technique: Long-length Partials (on all reps of the last set)
exercises.note: Set the seat back as far as comfortable, grip the handles hard to pull your butt down into the seat, and use a 2-3s negative.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Press
exercises.note: 1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Roll your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet rather than just bouncing onto your toes.

exercises.name: Weak Point Exercise 1
exercises.note: Pick ONE exercise for your chosen weak point from the Weak Points Table and perform it for the listed sets and reps.

exercises.name: Weak Point Exercise 2 (optional)
exercises.note: If your weak point feels recovered (not sore or fatigued), perform Exercise 2; otherwise skip it this week.

exercises.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
exercises.technique: Long-length Partials (on all reps of the last set)
exercises.note: If you have a left-right biceps size imbalance, do 1 arm at a time starting with the weaker arm (RPE 9-10) and match those reps with the stronger arm.

exercises.name: Seated DB French Press
exercises.note: Place both palms under the dumbbell head for overhead extensions. Feel a deep triceps stretch at the bottom and avoid pausing at the top.

exercises.name: Bottom-2/3 Constant Tension Preacher Curl
exercises.note: Stay in the bottom 2/3 of the curl without squeezing all the way up. Keep triceps pinned to the pad with no pause at top or bottom.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Kickback
exercises.note: Do upright or bent over (whichever feels better). In the full squeeze, your upper arm should be positioned back behind your torso.

exercises.name: Roman Chair Leg Raise
exercises.note: Allow your lower back to round as you curl your legs up. Go until you hit RPE 9-10 (0-1 reps shy of failure) with controlled form.

exercises.name: Super-ROM Overhand Cable Row
exercises.note: Use a wide pulldown bar on a seated cable row with double overhand grip. Lean forward on the negative and extend upright as you finish the row.

exercises.name: Arms-Extended 45° Hyperextension
exercises.note: Keep your arms extended out at 45° as you perform back extensions to target mid-back and lower back.

exercises.name: Lean-Back Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Start upright, lean back ~15-30° as you pull the bar down to lightly touch your chest, keeping the weight controlled.

exercises.name: Inverse DB Zottman Curl
exercises.note: Hammer curl on the positive, rotate palms up at the top, and lower with a palms-up grip on the negative.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Flye (Mechanical Dropset)
exercises.note: Take ~3 big steps back for 5 reps, immediately step forward once for 4 reps, then step forward again for 3+ reps to RPE 9-10.

exercises.name: Cable Paused Shrug-In
exercises.note: Shrug up and in ('up to your ears') with a 1-2s pause in the top squeeze and a 1-2s pause in the bottom stretch.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.note: Ensure elbows break at least 90° with smooth, controlled reps and strong mind-muscle connection with your delts.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Cable Y-Raise
exercises.note: Think about 'drawing a sword' on the positive, sweeping your arm up, out, and across your body.

exercises.name: Paused Assisted Dip
exercises.note: Slow 2-3s negative, 1-2s pause at the bottom, explode with control up. Go as deep as shoulders comfortably allow (break 90° elbow angle).

exercises.name: Low-Incline Dumbbell Flye
exercises.technique: Long-length Partials (on all reps of the last set)
exercises.note: Focus on a deep pec stretch at the bottom and stay in the bottom ~3/4 ROM where pec tension stays high.

exercises.name: Katana Triceps Extension
exercises.note: Flare elbows out at ~45° and keep your upper arms locked in place as you extend.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.note: Use your abs (not just hip hinge) to lower under control and pull back up; gradually increase ROM week to week.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.technique: Long-length Partials (on all reps of the last set)
exercises.note: Set the machine for maximum stretch at the bottom and keep your hips/butt pressed into the pad as you curl.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.note: Place feet lower on the platform for quad focus, go as deep as possible without excessive lower-back rounding, control the negative, and pause briefly at the bottom.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Lunge
exercises.note: 2 sets per leg. Minimize push from the back leg and focus on driving through the front leg/glutes.

exercises.name: Machine Hip Adduction
exercises.note: Focus on a strong mind-muscle connection with your inner thighs; push these hard for front thigh mass.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.note: Allow heels to lift onto your toes and push knees forward past toes. Safe if knees feel good; swap if you feel knee pain.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.note: 1-2 second pause at the bottom stretch of each rep; roll ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Weak Point Exercise 1
exercises.note: Pick ONE exercise for your chosen weak point from the Weak Points Table and perform it for the listed sets and reps.

exercises.name: Weak Point Exercise 2 (optional)
exercises.note: If your weak point feels recovered (not sore or fatigued), perform Exercise 2; otherwise skip it this week.

exercises.name: Cable Skull Crusher
exercises.note: Allow the cable to move back behind your head for maximum triceps stretch; reach full extension with elbows around eye level.

exercises.name: Kneeling Overhead Cable Curl
exercises.note: Kneel down, hold arm straight out to the side, and curl toward your head for a strong peak squeeze.

exercises.name: Triceps Diverging Pressdown (Long Rope or 2 Ropes)
exercises.note: Use two long ropes or one long rope. Lean slightly forward, flare elbows slightly out with arms back in line with torso, and squeeze hard at the bottom.

exercises.name: Incline DB Stretch-Curl
exercises.note: Keep upper back planted against the bench, rotate arms outward for a huge biceps stretch, go light and focus on squeezing.

exercises.note: Use a 3-4 second negative and a slight pause at the bottom stretch of each rep.

exercises.name: Triceps Diverging Pressdown (Long Rope or 2 Ropes)
exercises.note: Use two long ropes or one long rope. Lean slightly forward, flare elbows slightly out with arms back in line with torso, and squeeze hard at the bottom.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Cable Curl
exercises.note: Grip a cable bar with palms facing down to target forearms, brachialis, and biceps.

exercises.name: Roman Chair Leg Raise
exercises.note: Allow your lower back to round as you curl your legs up. Go until you hit RPE 9-10 (0-1 reps shy of failure) with controlled form.

exercises.name: Dual-Handle Lat Pulldown (Mid-back + Lats)
exercises.note: Lean back ~15° and drive elbows down while squeezing shoulder blades together to hit both lats and mid-traps.

exercises.name: Arms-Extended 45° Hyperextension
exercises.note: Keep your arms extended out at 45° as you perform back extensions to target mid-back and lower back.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
exercises.technique: Long-length Partials (on all reps of the last set)
exercises.note: Flare elbows out at roughly 45° and squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Concentration Cable Curl
exercises.note: Brace your working elbow against your knee and perform strict, controlled curls.

exercises.name: Rear Delt 45° Cable Flye
exercises.note: Pull one arm at a time, bracing with your free hand; align your arm and the cable in a straight line at the bottom.

exercises.name: Seated DB Shoulder Press
exercises.note: Slightly rotate dumbbells in on the negative and flare elbows out as you press.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Cable Y-Raise
exercises.note: Think about 'drawing a sword' on the positive, sweeping your arm up, out, and across your body.

exercises.name: Decline Machine Chest Press
exercises.note: Feel your lower pecs stretching apart on the negative with a strong mind-muscle connection.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension (Bar)
exercises.note: Feel a deep stretch on the triceps throughout the entire negative. Pause for 1 second in the stretched position on each rep.

exercises.name: Stomach Vacuums
exercises.note: Exhale, suck your stomach in, and hold for 10-15 seconds; repeat twice.

exercises.name: Super-ROM DB Lateral Raise
exercises.note: Perform lateral raises all the way overhead to involve upper traps at the top (stop at parallel with thumbs up if shoulder pain occurs).

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.technique: Long-length Partials (on all reps of the last set)
exercises.note: Set the machine for maximum stretch at the bottom and keep your hips/butt pressed into the pad as you curl.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
exercises.note: Step one leg back on the negative and drive the weight up with your front leg, minimizing back-leg assistance.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.note: Set the seat back as far as comfortable, grip the handles hard to pull your butt down into the seat, and use a 2-3s negative.

exercises.name: Machine Hip Adduction
exercises.note: Focus on a strong mind-muscle connection with your inner thighs; push these hard for front thigh mass.

exercises.name: Machine Hip Abduction
exercises.note: Use pads if possible to increase ROM; lean forward grabbing the rails to stretch the glutes further.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.note: 1-2 second pause at the bottom stretch of each rep; roll ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Weak Point Exercise 1
exercises.note: Pick ONE exercise for your chosen weak point from the Weak Points Table and perform it for the listed sets and reps.

exercises.name: Weak Point Exercise 2 (optional)
exercises.note: If your weak point feels recovered (not sore or fatigued), perform Exercise 2; otherwise skip it this week.

exercises.name: Triceps Pressdown (Bar)
exercises.note: Meant to be fairly heavy using a bar instead of a rope. Aim to add weight week to week while keeping form tight.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.note: Squeeze the dumbbell hard in the middle of the handle (liquid chalk helps keep your hand centered).

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Kickback
exercises.note: Do upright or bent over (whichever feels better). In the full squeeze, your upper arm should be positioned back behind your torso.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Russian Twists
exercises.note: Hold the ball out far from your body on each side and control every rep rather than rushing.

programNotes: Asynchronous 6-day Push/Pull/Legs/Arms split running on a 10-day cycle (not a fixed 7-day calendar week).
Block 1 (Weeks 1-4): Build phase; Week 5: Semi-Deload (~RPE 7-8, reduced volume); Block 2 (Weeks 6-10): Novelty phase.
Working sets are split into Early Sets (slightly lower RPE, ~1-2 reps shy of failure) and Last Set (pushed to RPE 10 failure on most isolation/machine lifts).
Perform the General Warm-Up + Exercise-Specific Warm-Up Pyramid before lifting (5-10 min total).

general: 5-10 min light cardio (treadmill, stairmaster, elliptical, bike)
10/side: Arm Swings, Arm Circles, Front-to-Back Leg Swings, Side-to-Side Leg Swings
